question: Which metrical form of the goddess is invoked to protect the face?
premises: The goddess has the form of the paṅkti meter.
She is sovereign of the gods.
She is asked to protect the face.
inference: The goddess in the form of paṅkti meter, sovereign of the gods, protects the face.
plain_english: May the sovereign of the gods, whose own form is the paṅkti meter, indeed protect the face.
